items.quote: because they lived a long way from Sidon and had no relationship with anyone else.
items.contrast: Their geographical isolation and lack of relationships, rather than the attackers’ use of swords.
items.reason: The passage explicitly gives two causes for the absence of rescuers: Laish was far from Sidon and had no relationship with anyone else. The sword attack describes what happened to them, not why no one could rescue them.
